name: Garvin the Tracker

abilities.name: Noxious Boulder
abilities.description: Garvin channels a green spell that shoots a large boulder at the target, which stuns those who do not block and will create a toxic AoE when it hits the ground. Can be aimed at Monstrous Dunerippers to kill them

abilities.name: Vanishing Powder
abilities.description: Garvin teleports away to set traps. Sister Chana's tracking spell will reveal his location by outlining him.

abilities.name: Hunter's Trap
abilities.description: Traps that are cast after he disappears, setting them up in corners of the room. Will cause bleeding damage.

abilities.name: Piercing Dervish
abilities.description: Casts a damage over time effect in an hourglass shaped radius

abilities.name: Wild Spores
abilities.description: Garvin puts a highly damaging damage over time effect on everyone for 8 seconds, giving everyone a green aura. Should be outhealed to avoid damage.

abilities.name: Venom Eruption
abilities.description: Garvin holds his dagger up and lets out bursts of venom in a large area around him. Using rocks as cover can block the damage.

abilities.name: Ricochet (Veteran only)
abilities.description: Garvin puts Ricochet on two players; if they come into contact with each other, they will take massive damage

abilities.name: Duneripper Spawn
abilities.description: Around 70% and 40% health, will summon dunerippers.

abilities.name: Summon Storm Mage
abilities.description: Around 80% health, will summon a storm mage that electrifies the waters.

dialogue.speaker: Garvin the Tracker
dialogue.trigger: When you approach the entrance to the Underground Monastery in the Secluded Cave, Garvin the Tracker will be seen at the top of the staircase, where he will hurl a boulder at Hushiah and Mubanat before vanishing

dialogue.speaker: Hushiah and Mubanat
dialogue.line: <Grunt and get knocked off the ledge>
dialogue.trigger: When you approach the entrance to the Underground Monastery in the Secluded Cave, Garvin the Tracker will be seen at the top of the staircase, where he will hurl a boulder at Hushiah and Mubanat before vanishing

dialogue.speaker: Garvin the Tracker
dialogue.trigger: As you make your way through the monastery rooms, you will be attacked by Garvin when exiting Lewin Frey's chamber, where he will hurl the Noxious Boulders as a trap before vanishing once again

dialogue.speaker: Khafdeed
dialogue.line: He's the dog who sniffed our island out. The tracker who led Orpheon's army here.
dialogue.trigger: When you reach him in his main chamber of the Inlet Grotto, Sister Chana and Khafdeed will arrive beside you

dialogue.speaker: Sister Chana Nirine
dialogue.line: There's something familiar about his magic. I can help.
dialogue.trigger: When you reach him in his main chamber of the Inlet Grotto, Sister Chana and Khafdeed will arrive beside you

dialogue.speaker: Khafdeed
dialogue.line: Help from up here. I can protect you from attacks or uneven terrain. Not both.
dialogue.trigger: When you reach him in his main chamber of the Inlet Grotto, Sister Chana and Khafdeed will arrive beside you

related_quests: Upstart Emperor: Repel an invading army from Lep Seclusa and secure an Elder Scroll.
Pledge: Lep Seclusa: Explore Lep Seclusa and return Undaunted.
summary: Garvin the Tracker is a Breton soldier who tracked down the island of Lep Seclusa and led Orpheon's army to it. He serves as the first boss of the dungeon. He uses many poison-based attacks.
